title: Start with the two crash bugs
explanation: This is the presentation’s exact starting file. The normal calls work; the empty-list and None-user cases crash. The fixture stays unchanged while each run resets a separate working copy.

title: Reset only the disposable working copy
explanation: Every submitted run copies the buggy fixture to .runtime/bugfix-workspace/utils.py. The app never replaces its fixture with a prewritten fix. This makes classroom repetitions comparable.

title: Choose tools and edit approvals
explanation: tools sets availability; allowedTools sets automatic approvals. acceptEdits is the lesson’s edit permission mode. Additional path checks limit this host’s file operations to the one demo target. No Bash or external search is enabled.

title: Call query and consume its messages
explanation: One query object can contain repeated model/tool interactions. The host forwards selected evidence and waits for a final result; finally closes the query and reads the resulting file.

title: Separate assistant text from the final result
explanation: Assistant messages can contain text and tool requests. A successful final outcome requires success subtype with no error flag. A tool request alone is not proof that an edit was applied.

title: Run independent Python regression checks
explanation: The test runner lives outside the agent working directory. It checks two ordinary calls and the two edge cases. This app chooses 0 for an empty average and an empty string for a missing user; those are explicit classroom contracts, not the only possible API design.
code:
"""Trusted host regression checks; lives outside the agent working directory."""
import contextlib,importlib.util,io,json,sys

cases=[]
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
 try:
  spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('student_utils',sys.argv[1])
  module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
  tests=[('Average: ordinary list','calculate_average',[2,4,6],4),
         ('Average: empty list','calculate_average',[],0),
         ('Name: ordinary user','get_user_name',{'name':'Ada'},'ADA'),
         ('Name: missing user','get_user_name',None,'')]
  for label,name,arg,expected in tests:
   try:
    actual=getattr(module,name)(arg)
    cases.append(dict(label=label,expected=expected,actual=actual,passed=actual==expected))
   except Exception as error:
    cases.append(dict(label=label,expected=expected,error=type(error).__name__,passed=False))
 except Exception as error:
  cases=[dict(label='Import repaired utils.py',expected='valid Python module',error=type(error).__name__,passed=False)]
print(json.dumps(dict(available=True,passed=sum(c['passed'] for c in cases),total=4,cases=cases),default=str))

title: Print tool activity and verification evidence
explanation: The terminal prints SDK progress and the independent check count. It exits unsuccessfully if the file did not change or the post-run checks did not all pass. The web page shows both kinds of evidence separately.
